reason: Tuber-like means thickened and swollen like a tuber, which is the definition of tuberous.
Bicoloured is a case of multi-colored. The count of two is lost, but the parent class is safe.
Crown-shaped means crown like.
Slimy means mucoid.
Semiscandent means partly climbing or scrambling. The existing climbing and scrambling mapping already treats these as one habit.
Lunulate means crescent-shaped.
Semi-exserted means only partly projecting. Mapping it to exserted loses the 'partly'. Reject, or keep as a phrase for review.
Laminated means in thin layers, which fits stratified only for layered structures. On leaves it can mean lamina-like.
Lax-flowered means flowers loosely arranged on an inflorescence. The loose quality belongs to the inflorescence, and the bearer 'flower' is lost. Use inflorescence + loose, or reject.
Faveolate means honeycombed, the same as alveolate.
Defoliated means leafless, the leaves having been shed, so leaf absent describes the state.
Non-decurrent means not decurrent.
Ternately lobed means three-lobed.
The colour is brown and the comparative 'darker' only modifies it. Brown is a safe parent.
Acrid means pungent or burning, not bitter. Use a pungent class if one exists, otherwise reject.
Not reticulate negates reticulate.
Without prickles means prickle absent.
The colour is yellow and 'darker' only modifies it.
Epigeous means growing above ground, which is aerial.
Glomerule is a noun for a dense cluster of flowers, which is a bearer or inflorescence type. It is not the quality capitate. The quality form would be glomerate.
Exstipulate means without stipules.
Decreasing is ambiguous because it can mean size or number. Tapered size fits only for organs that get smaller along an axis.
'Divided almost' is a fragment of 'divided almost to the base'. The depth is lost, and the word on its own is not a quality. Reject, or handle as a phrase.
Scutelliform means shallow dish or shield shaped, which is close to saucer-shaped (patelliform).
Spatheless means without a spathe.
Not perforated means not perforate.
Non-anastomosing means not anastomosing.
Closely set means close to its neighbours, which matches the approximate definition.
Unwrinkled means not wrinkled.
Glossy is a synonym of glistening, so not glossy means not glistening.
Spotless means not spotted.
Spurlike means spur shaped.
Without bristles means not setose.
Flowerless means without flowers.
Marine means living in the sea, so salt water is lost. Aquatic is a parent term, but the rule needs a marine or saline class or manual review.
Lacinate is a spelling variant of laciniate.
In-rolled means rolled inward, which is involute.
Ovulate means female. The cone|strobilus constraint is right.
Ring-like means ring shaped.
Cincinnate describes an inflorescence or branching that is a cincinnus (scorpioid). It is not a presence of a separate part, so keep it to inflorescence-type bearers.
Interlaced means intertwined, which fits tangled.
Mammiform means breast or nipple shaped, which is close to papillary. It is not exact.
Not mucronate negates mucronate.
Ill-defined means indistinct or not sharply delimited, as with margins or limits. It does not mean inconspicuous (hard to see).
Not grooved negates grooved.
Knee-like means geniculate, or abruptly bent.
Ear-like means auriculate.
Leaf-bearing means the part has leaves.
Lipped means two-lipped. The constraint to corolla|calyx|perianth is right.
Edentate means without teeth, so not dentated.
